data.name: Musaib
data.gender_notes: Musaib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musaib is an Arabic name that means 'one who is tested by trials' or 'one who faces difficulties'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'musiba', which means 'trial' or 'test'. The name Musaib carries the meaning “Tested by trials” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musaib usually hope their child will grow to embody tested by trials and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Musaib symbolizes resilience and patience in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Musaib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tested by trials.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musaib total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
